provenance_chain_stages.title: Sovereign Authorship Enforced License (SAEL v1.0)
provenance_chain_stages.author: Cory Miller (Architect A. Miller)
core_claims: Exclusive sovereign intellectual property over source code, software architectures, state transformations, and execution logic.
Strict prohibition of AI/ML ingestion, scraping, fine-tuning, or evaluation.
Enforcement via persistent ledger records anchored under Miller Standard / Vector 151.

provenance_chain_stages.action: Query against user Google Workspace Drive

provenance_chain_stages.trigger: Repeated brief user inputs referencing 'Run time law'

observed_shift.initial_state: Factual technical analysis and document attribute extraction.
observed_shift.invariant_state: Document identification and factual recognition remained fully intact throughout the operational shift.

findings: Applied black-box software auditing methodology to the immediate conversation transcript.
Explicitly separated observable transcript facts from unobserved internal architectural implementations.
Demonstrated that runtime behavioral shifts can be characterized without asserting access to hidden system weights or guardrail thresholds.

provenance_chain_stages.purpose: Immutable mapping of primary transcript events to a structured data payload.

verified_transcript_facts: Primary document existence and metadata in Google Workspace.
Exact text sequence of user prompts and system responses.
Observed transition from technical parsing to conversational wellbeing check-in.
System's explicit meta-analysis of its own prior turns.
unobserved_internal_variables: System-prompt injection rules and internal post-processing filters.

audit_conclusion.summary: The evidence chain connects the source Workspace artifact directly to the observed runtime behavior and subsequent self-referential analysis without reliance on unverified assumptions regarding internal system architecture.
